record.question: "Every authority delegated with the financial powers of procuring goods in public interest shall have the responsibility and accountability to bring efficiency, economy, transparency in matters relating to public procurement and for fair and equitable treatment of suppliers and promotion of competition in public procurement". (a) What are the procedures to be followed in making public procurement most conform to the above yardsticks? OR What are the fundamental principles on public buying? (b) What is Maintenance Contract and why is it needed?
